results.rationale: Consistency: The broad white door surface becomes a narrow vertical metal strip with a visible side edge and two additional large holes; framing, mounting-plate proportions, and perspective also change. Most major surrounding details are altered. Instruction: The edit changes the mounting presentation but leaves the black open-ended spindle exposed. A completed doorknob should provide a finished graspable knob over this mechanism; that change is absent. Quality: Structural coherence, naturalness, artifact absence, and surface texture are satisfactory; the exposed mechanical assembly, worn paint, and metal shading form a coherent image.

Consistency: The two-object arrangement becomes one centered charger; the large charger's body proportions, position, visible top detail, and printed labels change. The pale background remains broadly similar, but most major object details and composition do not. Instruction: The small right charger disappears, leaving a single charger resembling the original larger one. The expected result is two chargers of matching size with the smaller charger enlarged; removal does not fulfill this. Quality: The charger body, ports, lighting, and grounding shadow are coherent, with satisfactory surface texture and no duplication. The port labels have visibly malformed characters, a clear text artifact.
